A personal approach to travel

Meet Us

Jacobin & Bernice Safaris helps travellers plan memorable tours across Tanzania, from classic wildlife safaris to tailor-made adventures and relaxing Zanzibar holidays.

Every traveller has a different idea of the perfect journey. Share what you love, when you want to travel and what matters most to you, and let's explore the possibilities together.

  • Customised safari and tour ideas
  • Options for different travel styles and budgets
  • Wildlife, landscapes, culture and beach experiences
  • Direct communication before you travel
  • Responsible travel that respects wildlife and local cultures
Let's plan together ↗
Travel with purpose

Conservation and community matter

We believe memorable journeys should respect the places and people that make them special. We encourage responsible wildlife viewing, following park rules, reducing waste and choosing experiences that respect local culture.

Respect for nature

Encourage low-impact travel, wildlife-safe behaviour, responsible waste disposal and respect for protected habitats.

Local community support

Where possible, include locally owned accommodation, guides, makers and cultural experiences that are community-led and fairly paid.

Responsible wildlife encounters

Keep a respectful distance, follow guide and ranger instructions, and never disturb or feed wild animals.

We aim to support these principles through the choices we make with guests and partners; specific donations or formal conservation partnerships will only be listed when confirmed.

Ideas to help you plan

Sample itineraries

These example routes show how a trip might flow. They are not fixed offers; nights, accommodation, flights, activities and pricing can be adjusted to your dates and preferences.

8 days · Northern Tanzania

Classic Northern Circuit Safari

Day 1: Arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport and transfer to Arusha for your overnight stay.
Day 2: Game drive in Tarangire National Park. Overnight in the Manyara area.
Day 3: Travel to Serengeti National Park and enjoy a game drive.
Day 4: Full-day game drive in Serengeti National Park.
Day 5: Another full-day game drive in Serengeti National Park.
Day 6: Travel to the Ngorongoro area for an overnight stay.
Day 7: Game drive in Ngorongoro Crater.
Day 8: Transfer for your departure.

Enquire about this itinerary ↗
10 days · Safari & Zanzibar

Wildlife to Zanzibar

Day 1: Arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport and overnight in Arusha.
Day 2: Game drive in Tarangire National Park. Overnight in the Manyara area.
Day 3: Travel to Serengeti National Park and enjoy a game drive.
Day 4: Full-day Serengeti game drive.
Day 5: Full-day Serengeti game drive.
Day 6: Ngorongoro Crater game drive.
Day 7: Fly to Zanzibar.
Day 8: Enjoy Zanzibar at your own pace.
Day 9: Discover Zanzibar's beaches, culture or optional excursions.
Day 10: Depart.

Enquire about this itinerary ↗
5 days · Serengeti & Ngorongoro

Fly-in Serengeti Adventure

Day 1: Fly into Serengeti National Park and transfer to your camp or lodge.
Day 2: Game drive in Serengeti National Park.
Day 3: Game drive in Serengeti National Park.
Day 4: Enjoy a morning game drive and travel toward the Ngorongoro area.
Day 5: Ngorongoro Crater game drive, followed by departure if flight timing allows; otherwise, an additional overnight may be needed.

Enquire about this itinerary ↗
6 days · Southern Tanzania

Nyerere / Selous Wilderness

Day 1: Fly into Nyerere National Park / Selous and transfer to your lodge.
Day 2: Game drive in Nyerere National Park / Selous.
Day 3: Game drive and wildlife viewing.
Day 4: Game drive in the park.
Day 5: Enjoy another game drive, a permitted boat safari or a guided activity available at your lodge.
Day 6: Depart, subject to flight schedule and transfer arrangements.

Travel times and activity availability depend on season, park regulations, flight schedules and accommodation location. We will confirm the practical details when tailoring your trip.
